content: We need to use functional group names from list. For carboxylic acid, the list includes "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and "aromatic carboxylic acid". Our target has a C(=O)N attached to aromatic ring? The substructure is /C=C/C(=O)N... That's an aliphatic carboxylic acid? It's a carbonyl attached to a double bond, not aromatic. So use "aliphatic carboxylic acid". For amide formation, functional group formed is "amide". So search with broken "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and formed "amide".
